summary: Arrow Financial Corporation filed an 8-K reporting that its planned merger with Adirondack Bancorp, under which Adirondack merges into Arrow, received stockholder approval from Adirondack on June 9, 2026, and regulatory approvals from the New York State Department of Financial Services and the OCC. Arrow also received a waiver from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York. The transaction, expected to close July 1, 2026, is a previously announced merger, not a new special situation; this filing merely updates procedural milestones. No deal terms are restated.
